events.name: FORCE FEST 2K26
events.description: Apeejay School, Panchsheel Park presents the 25th edition of FORCE FEST 2K26, a flagship technology and innovation festival themed 'TechnoGenesis: Evolution with Technology'. The festival provides exceptionally talented students a dynamic platform to explore, create, innovate, and showcase their technological prowess across various exciting competitions. Events range from PC gaming and block coding to robotics, quizzes, app development, and more.
rules: Kindly confirm participation in the respective events by October 15, 2026.
Detailed list of events, schedule, rules, and regulations apply to the various competitions.

events.name: Technophilia 7.0 - Autonomous AI Eco Agents
events.classes: Class I to XII and Open
events.description: Mamta Modern School presents Technophilia 7.0, a digital venture celebrating creativity, technology, innovation, and purposeful action under the theme 'Autonomous AI Eco Agents: From Prompt to Action for a Sustainable Future.' The event features 17 thought-provoking and skill-enhancing competitions designed to inspire young minds to explore how technology can address real-world environmental and social challenges. Participating students will engage in various offline and online events ranging from coding and AI models to quizzes, gaming, and digital arts.
rules: Schools must register latest by 5 October 2026.
Schools must join the Discord server for online events.
Participation in multiple events by a single individual or team is only allowed in online events.
Each event has three prizes (1st, 2nd, and 3rd).
Any explicit behaviour or disregard of morality by any participant would lead to progressive disqualification.
Only one entry will be permitted per school for each event.
Participants must be accompanied by only one teacher escort on the day of the events.
Participants are required to carry their school IDs and wear school uniforms unless required to be dressed up in a particular costume.
All participants must report at 07:45 am sharp.

events.name: MODEM Annual Technology Fest
events.venue: Modern School, Vasant Vihar, Poorvi Marg, New Delhi 110057
events.description: Modern School, Vasant Vihar presents MODEM, an annual inter-school technology fest bringing together young minds from across Delhi NCR. The event features engaging competitions and thought-provoking activities designed to foster critical thinking, collaborative problem-solving, and computational excellence.
rules: Only one team per school, per event is allowed.
All teams must be accompanied by a teacher.
Indiscipline and/or non-adherence will invite penalty and/or disqualification.
Decision of the judges will be final and binding.

events.name: AlphaBit '26
events.description: Amity International School, Saket presents AlphaBit '26, an annual tech fest fostering innovation and providing a platform for young minds to connect, share ideas, and explore the ever-evolving landscape of technology. The event encourages students from diverse technological fields to showcase their skills and express their boundless imagination and creativity. Participants can take part in various competitions including Innovat-a-thon, Creatica, Debug.log, and Q?Bit.
rules: Reporting Date & Time: 6th November 2026; 8:30 am
1 Team per school
2 Participants per team

events.name: Aqua Regia - The School Quiz
events.description: Aqua Regia – The Ultimate All-India Inter-School Quiz Challenge is Back! The quiz will be conducted across 45+ cities and towns in India, offering a platform for students to showcase their awareness, wit, and intellect. The preliminary round will consist of a school-level written quiz of 30 questions with a test duration of 25 minutes.
rules: Teams must consist of two members each, with both members studying in the same class.
Prior registration is compulsory for the City and Zonal Finals.
Students must be dressed in school uniform for the quiz at all levels.
If either member is unable to attend the next round, the team will be disqualified.

events.name: 16th SPARK Innovation Awards
events.description: The SPARK Innovation Awards by Dr. KV Rao Scientific Society (KVRSS) offer a premier national platform designed to unleash creative and scientific excellence among school students. Students are encouraged to develop inventive solutions for real-world science and technology challenges. Participants can present their original scientific concepts, research projects, and technological prototypes to esteemed scientists and academicians.
rules: Access Registration Portal and read the registration guidelines thoroughly.
Complete the online submission with all required student, school, and project details.
Registration is considered COMPLETE and ACCEPTED by KVRSS only after the School Principal grants official approval via the automated email link.

events.name: 17th Rajagiri National Business Quiz
events.description: Register for the 17th Rajagiri National Business Quiz and compete for a ₹3,82,000 prize pool. This prestigious business quiz is hosted by Rajagiri College of Social Sciences and Rajagiri Business School. Online preliminary rounds take place on October 24 and October 25, 2026.
